content: in october 2023 a civil case was heard in the taurage district court regarding the division of matrimonial property in a divorce case the court decided to dissolve the marriage and awarded a vehicle to the applicant the applicant is seeking the dissolution of the marriage wants to retain their married surname establish their childs place of residence and receive monthly maintenance for the child the court will determine if the vehicle is personal or community property based on evidence provided the court will also address maintenance between the spouses the defendant must file a statement of defense the applicant has been granted legal aid and the defendant is responsible for costs the court dissolved the marriage declared the vehicle as the applicants personal property and ordered the defendant to pay legal aid costs stamp duty and postage costs
